name: XAU_DIRECTIONAL_CONSOLIDATION_V1
purpose: Consolidate Phase I-H robust survivors into a small non-redundant directional candidate set before any protected OOS request.
notes: This phase does not add or relax any scientific pass gate from I-H; it only removes redundancy among already robust directional survivors.
No 2026 access, PnL, sizing, stop/target optimization, execution optimization, or Challenge Lab is permitted.
A surviving representative is still a phenomenon candidate. Protected final OOS requires a separate committed preregistration and explicit owner approval under the current supervisor instruction.
